visualReview: Assistant screening only; all new photos require human review. Markers remain unknown.

searchPolicy.primary: Research-grade, non-captive, exact species name; photo-level CC0, no flags or hidden photos, original dimensions >=400px. Up to 30 observations per species ordered by votes.
searchPolicy.expanded: Same photo-level rights/dimension checks, all observation quality grades and cultivated status. Non-research photos explicitly warned in captions.
searchPolicy.scope: Only entries with zero photos at the start; the two entries covered by the user export were excluded from additions. No existing profile photos replaced.
searchPolicy.presentation: Reference entries remain checklist entries; adding draft photos does not certify an identification profile.

synonymCheck.decision: Synonym documented, but candidate photo rejected for insufficient visual detail.
